hook: A camshaft defect is forcing Toyota to recall 62,000 non-hybrid Tundra trucks for safety repairs.

sections.voiceover: A camshaft defect is forcing Toyota to recall 62,000 non-hybrid Tundra trucks for safety repairs.
Toyota is recalling 62,000 non-hybrid Tundra pickups from model years 2022-2023 and 2025-2026. Does this camshaft defect in Toyota Tundra trucks cause a sudden loss of drive power?
Though 62,000 vehicles are recalled, only 300 camshafts are estimated faulty.
The snapping camshaft causes a sudden loss of drive power for the driver. Toyota manages the recall of these 62,000 non-hybrid Tundra trucks from their headquarters in Plano, Texas.
